notes: All three years taken from the FY2026 Annual Report (segment note for FY2025-FY2026, five-year record for FY2024; the FY2025 figures agree in both). Continuing operations only: YNAP (online distributors) is presented as discontinued operations; the five-year record says only FY2022 was re-presented, so FY2024 is on the same basis. 'Other' is a reported business area (mainly Fashion & Accessories Maisons), kept as a segment. The other line is computed as unallocated corporate costs (-417 / -453 / -517) plus impact of valuation adjustments on acquisitions (-31 / -49 / -39); both items are published separately. FY2026 corporate costs include EUR 134m net one-off charges (impairments and a write-down linked to the agreed sale of Baume & Mercier to the Damiani Group, closing expected summer 2026). Group operating profit FY2026 includes EUR 164m of non-recurring costs. The 'Other' brands come from the press release ('About Richemont'); the segment note also lists Watchfinder, investment property companies and other manufacturing entities in Other. Segment revenue has no intersegment eliminations (segment sales sum to Group sales).
